what: Inside a long section (usually 500vh), several sentences stacked in one spot swap at each scroll range — the progress through the section from top to bottom is divided by the number of sentences, and when the range changes, the previous sentence’s words leave upward (−100%) inside the mask at .35s · .01 stagger, and .1s later the next sentence’s words rise in from below (100%) (curve 0.65,0,0.35,1). In the dot row below, only the current dot stretches from 5px to a 2.906em pill in .4s, and the white bar inside fills with the progress within the range (earlier dots full, later dots empty). If it skips more than two steps, it switches immediately.

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sentences to overlap (inside the same parent, overlapped with absolute)
options.dot: Width of the on dot, default ‹2.906em› · width of the off dot is dot-off (default 5px)
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default ‹top top› · end default ‹bottom bottom›

note: Pinning is done by the consumer’s sticky skin (the part only reads progress). The part sets the sentence box height to fit the longest sentence. It re-splits when the size changes so it still fits even if the font arrives late

from.where: index.html .db-stack (five sentences on the blue panel — original [data-swiper] initSwiper: SplitText words mask · .35s · .01 · dot 2.906em ↔ 5px .4s)
